ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance

be amended by changing all the Institutional Planned Development 456 symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 14-D in the area bounded by

       a line 200 feet north of the alley next north of and parallel to East 63rd Street; South
       Kenwood Avenue; a line 150 feet north of the alley next north of and parallel to East 63rd
       Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Kenwood Avenue

to those of an RM-5 District, Residential Multi-Unit District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.



Common Address: 6226 S. Kenwood Ave.




​      ​       ​       ​       ​       ​

                                               ____________________________________

                                               Jeanette Taylor

                                               Alderman, 20th Ward
